olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfies $\underbrace{f(f(\cdots f}_{f(n)\text{ times}}(n)\cdots))=\frac{n^2}{f(f(n))}$. Determine all possible values of $f(1000)$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2019

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Cyclic $ABCD$ with $AD^2+BC^2=AB^2$; diagonals meet at $E$; $P\in AB$ with $\angle APD=\angle BPC$. Show line $PE$ bisects $CD$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2019

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Let $K$ = set of positive integers without digit 7. Find all polynomials $f$ with nonneg­ative integer coefficients with $f(n)\in K$ whenever $n\in K$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2019

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Find the number of ways to choose $(n+1)^2$ sets $S_{i,j}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,2n\}$ for $0\leq i,j\leq n$ with $|S_{i,j}|=i+j$ and $S_{i,j}\subseteq S_{k,l}$ whenever $i\leq k,j\leq l$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2019

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Rationals $\frac{m}{n}$ and $\frac{m}{n}$ on a board (actually $\frac{m}{n}$ written twice, where $\gcd(m,n)=1$). Evan can write the arithmetic or harmonic mean of any two numbers on the board. Find all $(m,n)$ such that Evan can write 1 in finitely many steps.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2019

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Find all real polynomials $P$ with $\frac{P(x)}{yz}+\frac{P(y)}{zx}+\frac{P(z)}{xy}=P(x-y)+P(y-z)+P(z-x)$ for nonzero $x,y,z$ with $2xyz=x+y+z$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 2019
